title: Annex source
description: Woodcore-Datei/annexes/sources/<id>.json, schema 1.0 -- one document the report draws on from outside, a FEM program's print report first (docs/domain/documents.md §3.3octodecies). Its PDF is copied beside it as <id>.pdf, and a new version is written over it. Written by Woodcore's «Annexes» tab only, read by calc/domains/annex.py. Every rule the walker below cannot express -- an id that is a file name, a mode of the three -- is checked by annex.check_source.

schema_version.description: -- pinned: a file written at another version is refused rather than read as this one.

id.description: The file name of the record and of its PDF, and the string the report addresses the source by. Letters, digits and _ . + -.

name.description: What the report calls the source: in an excerpt's caption and on its annex's cover page.

group.description: Kept for the window's own use; nothing in the report reads it.

mode.description: What of the source the annexes carry: the pages an excerpt is taken from (used, the default), every page (all), or nothing (none).

original.description: The name of the file it was copied from, as the engineer chose it -- said in the window, printed nowhere.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of its PDF when the window last wrote it -- what the window compares a replaced version with. The export computes its own from the file.
